mostWorthwhile.text: Forming two daughter nuclei before dividing the cytoplasm was the strongest sequence: the continuous cell boundary and cleavage furrow clearly distinguish nuclear division from cell separation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The membrane-building vesicle picture mentions the ER and Golgi but does not explain their roles, leaving that connection less informative.

surprise.text: The vesicles fuse with the surface to add membrane, making cell growth more concrete than simply combining the ingredients.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked an overall purpose, though combining generic new proteins with centrosomes simplifies spindle assembly; tubulin is only identified in the result.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the daughter cells develop into different tissues, although the final stretch offered only one combination at each decision.
